questions.parentExplanation: 对应原文：科学社团只有一台放大摄像设备，供观察桌上的小物件。 我们轮流调镜头，其他人看大屏幕。 轮到我时，我犯了错，把设备移得太近。 画面变模糊了，但我没有碰下面的物体。 搭档让我把设备往后移一点，观察屏幕。 很快，小线条变清晰，我解释了哪次调整起了作用。 下一个人从这个设置开始，没有重复同样的错误。 因此正确选项为“Sharing equipment and learning from an adjustment error”。

questions.stem: Which title best fits the passage?
questions.explanation: The passage says: "Before the town play, our youth group helps build a simple street scene. I take an active part in painting the signs and suggesting where each should hang. My friend Aya first comes only to carry brushes and wash the pots. Soon she begins to take an interest in the lettering on the old shop signs. She studies photographs, then draws careful examples for us to compare. The director chooses one of her designs for the centre of the stage. Aya smiles when she sees it, surprised by how a small helping job opened a new interest." This supports the answer: "A Small Helping Job Opens a New Interest".
questions.parentExplanation: 对应原文：镇上戏剧开始前，我们青年小组帮忙搭建简单的街道场景。 我积极参与刷标牌，也建议每块该挂在哪。 朋友阿雅最初只是来搬画笔、洗罐子。 很快，她开始对旧店招上的字体产生兴趣。 她研究照片，再认真画出示例供我们比较。 导演选了她的一款设计，放在舞台中央。 看到它时，阿雅笑了，惊讶于一项小小帮忙竟开启了新兴趣。 因此正确选项为“A Small Helping Job Opens a New Interest”。
